# Terremoto Colombia · Mallanet.org

> Citizen emergency coordination map for the Colombia earthquake response.
> Not an official government emergency channel. In immediate danger, call **123**.

## Key facts

- Product: Terremoto Colombia (Mallanet.org initiative)
- Canonical site: https://terremotocolombia.co
- Contact: info@mallanet.org
- Role: citizen reports, missing-person directory, hospitals/shelters, collection centers, survival guide
- Official seismic parameters: Servicio Geológico Colombiano (SGC) — https://www.sgc.gov.co/sismos — X @sgcol
- National disaster coordination: UNGRD — https://portal.gestiondelriesgo.gov.co/ — X @UNGRD
- International seismic cross-check: USGS

## Reconstruction campaign, in short

- What it collects: cement (50 kg bags), rebar, brick or block, sand or
  gravel, roof tiles, timber, tools.
- How it works: the donor registers the donation and gets a ten-character
  code, delivers the material at a collection point, and a team member
  confirms the delivery there.
- Three figures, never added together: received (confirmed by a team member),
  pledged (not delivered yet), in transit (already on its way).
- Destination: families in Chocó that lost their home.
- A certificate reads "verified" only after a person at the point confirms
  the delivery.
